title:
POV: I ASKED A STRANGER IN ISRAEL IF HE WAS JEWISH
HE SAID HE WAS MUSLIM
beats: 'Are you Jewish?' 'No, I'm not Jewish.' 'Are you Christian?' 'I'm Muslim.' 'Wow, amazing - this is for you.'
'Where are you from?' 'Originally Sudan - I've lived in Israel 20 years.' 'And as a Muslim, is it safe?' 'It is safe.'
THE ENDING: 'What's your name, brother?' 'Tal. Keep smiling.' 'I made your day?' 'You made my day.' 'That was the point.'
